Android Native Backdrop Blur Demonstration

Identical Scroll Position (scrollY=210) · Same Content Behind Surface Across All Three States

State 1: Blur Level 0 (0px / 0%)
State 2: Blur Level 40 (100% Native Frosted Glass)
State 3: Reduced Transparency (Solid Opaque Surface)
Technical Invariants & Verification Evidence:
1. Identical Content Alignment: In all three captures, the scroll view is locked at scrollY=210 so the Profile Card ("Alice Cooper") and Quick Actions sit directly under the sticky page header.
2. Blur Level 0: Renders unblurred translucent glass. The avatar squircle and text behind the header remain crisply visible through the surfaceHeader background.
3. Blur Level 40: Renders full native backdrop blur via expo-blur with dimezisBlurViewSdk31Plus and BlurTargetView ref. Content behind the header is softly diffused and frosted.
4. Reduced Transparency: Renders a completely solid, high-contrast surface (palette.surface) with borderStrong, fully occluding background content for accessibility compliance.
